resource_accounting.external_allowance_scope: preflight and auxiliary analysis, auditing, plotting, archival, reporting; measured auxiliary times are subsets, not additions to this inclusive accounting

reporting_correction: One-time head/reset edits; all parameters subsequently learn. Prose only; frozen experiment/spec/statistical calculations unchanged. See analyzer_reporting_change.json.
archived_reanalysis_identical: All contrasts, seed contrasts, and arm means byte-identical; raw path columns relocated.
historical_path_resolution: Raw records, earlier standalone reviews, and launch manifests retain original execution-time paths. Resolve those through backup_manifest.json.
limitations: No model forward or training is replayed. Intermediate no-LN task2..9 exactness is checked from runner records; only saved task1/task10 tensors are independently compared.
B image tensor/path hashes are checked across all paired conditions; original JPEG-to-tensor bytes are not reconstructed.
B canonical fresh-model initialization is not rebuilt; initial/F0 fingerprints are checked across R/ELU and fresh-Adam/zero-head semantics against saved evidence.
Native/compiled numerical-check success flags are audited, but forward/backward numerical comparisons are not rerun.
